component.name: Nikomiru
component.summary: Watch videos in Japanese, look words up and make Anki cards
Guarda video in giapponese, cerca le parole e crea carte Anki

description.p: Nikomiru is a video player for learning Japanese. Every word of the subtitles can be clicked to look it up in your Yomitan dictionaries, and turned into an Anki card in one click.

ul.li: Clickable subtitles: SRT, ASS, WebVTT and the tracks inside the video
Yomitan dictionaries: terms, kanji, frequencies and pitch accent
Anki cards with the sentence, the frame, the audio of the line and a link back to the scene
Subtitles from Jimaku and OpenSubtitles, aligned with the audio
A library of your series, statistics of your study
The whole app works from the keyboard

description.p: Nothing goes online unless you ask for it.
